name: agent-crew
description: A crew of AI agents (PM, critic, architect, QA, frontend, backend, DB, security) that turns an idea for a small-business tool into a working, tested project. All state lives in .crew/ in the project.

budget_cap_usd.title: Budget cap per project (USD)
budget_cap_usd.description: Stop a project once estimated spend reaches this amount. Only enforced exactly when a host reports real costs (API-key sessions, eval runs); on a subscription your plan limits apply.

stack_profile.title: Stack profile
stack_profile.description: Technology stack the crew builds with.

autonomy.title: Autonomy
autonomy.description: full: the crew only stops for escalations. review: the crew shows the brief and waits for your approval before building.

brief_review_minutes.title: Brief review wait (minutes)
brief_review_minutes.description: In review autonomy, how long a host UI waits for your brief approval before continuing.
